Unsheathed

by 烽火戏诸侯

4.5(1324 reviews)
4.81K views
967 chapters
0 saved

Chen Ping'an, a swordsman bearing the name of peace, wields a single blade to move mountains, invert seas, vanquish demons, challenge gods, pluck stars, shatter rivers, raze cities, and unlock the heavenly realm. The Midland world teems with marvels. A legendary scholar once carved a Milky Way waterfall with his sword. At the Edge Sea's precipice dwells a nameless Daoist, content with nothing but wind across his face. The Western Pure Land shelters an ancient monk dispensing chicken soup wisdom. In the Southern Wilderness, a blind painter commands towering golden-armored puppets to reshape the hundred thousand mountains into living art. From humble origins in the north, a destitute youth witnesses tens of thousands of Sword Kinesis Immortals descending like locusts. Driven by tales of the scholar, visions of the surging East Sea tides, the western sand wastes, and the majestic Southern peaks, he seizes a wooden sword and journeys south. His path intertwines with masters across the four corners of the world, where martial prowess, cultivation, and destiny converge in this Eastern fantasy of triumph and tragedy.
